coverage_note: Permits issued by the City of Buffalo only. Other Erie County jurisdictions publish their permits separately and are not in this feed; totals here are City of Buffalo totals, labeled as such.

dedupe_rule.definition: One published permit = one apno in the City of Buffalo's Permits dataset. The dataset's grain is one row per permit: no collapsing applies or is needed.
dedupe_rule.measurement: Trailing-12-month window (issued >= 2025-11-12), measured 2026-11-12 on the full paged pull saved as audit evidence: 11,359 rows = 11,359 distinct apno, 0 duplicates, 0 null permit numbers. The pipeline's in-batch duplicate gate and the (county_id, source_record_id) upsert key guard every future pull.

field_map.address: stname, as published (the full street address including house number, e.g. '130 MAIN'; present on 11,359 of 11,359 window permits; title-cased at normalization). The dataset publishes no separate house-number field.
field_map.application_date: Not published by the dataset (it carries an issue date and, on some permits, an expiration date only) — application_date stays NULL by construction.
field_map.category: New York State property_class_code, the state's own assessment classes: codes 200–299 (residential dwellings) = Residential (8,782 window permits); codes 400 and above (the state's commercial major class, including 411 Apartment) = Commercial (2,210); vacant-land (3xx), agricultural, and missing codes state no residential/commercial class and stay NULL (367).
field_map.contractor_rule: NO contractor name is carried. The dataset's applicant field mixes person names (the individual licensees and homeowners who applied) with business names with no role or business/person separation, so under SOP section 3 rule 1 it is never requested at all; inspector (city staff person names) and licno are likewise never requested. contractor_name is NULL on every Buffalo record (the San Francisco / Seattle treatment: no separable contractor business field is published).
field_map.issue_date: issued (a Socrata calendar_date). The window is defined on it: the dataset is an issued-permits register — its own notes state it does not contain pending permits.
field_map.permit_number: apno — verified exactly unique in the trailing-12-month window (11,359 distinct apno = 11,359 rows, 2026-11-12 audit).
field_map.permit_type_source: aptype, the city's own permit family naming (ELECTRICAL, PLUMBING, HEATING, REPAIR, REP-PLANS, GC, SIGN, ELEVATOR, DEMOLITION, TEAROUT, FENDRIVE, SWIM POOL, ...).
field_map.project_description: descofwork, as published, with embedded HTML markup stripped and entities unescaped at normalization (2,409 of 11,359 window descriptions arrive with markup).
field_map.status_source: The dataset publishes no status field and contains no pending permits, so status is 'issued' for every record by construction; status_source stays NULL.
field_map.valuation: value, the city's stated value of work. PASSED validation on the full window (2026-11-12): stated on 100% of window permits (0 null; $0 on 42, all of them USE permits stating no construction value; $1 on 472 — 344 of them electrical, an immaterial placeholder convention totaling $472; none negative); total $783,165,411.56; median positive $6,000. The dataset's own stated design — a phased project's whole cost appears on its first permit — was verified on the largest projects: the $139,636,000 North Aud Block redevelopment value at 130 Main St appears exactly once in the entire dataset (all-time count 1) while its sibling permits carry their own small scope values ($18,000 electrical, $7,500 sign); the $75,000,000 Towne Gardens figure states once in the window alongside per-building heating values on 36 separate building permits; the 575 Main elevator program splits its $1.8M evenly across its 7 elevator permits, so the stated shares sum to the program total rather than restating it. Same-address + same-value groups above $10k bound any restatement excess at $6,984,823.84 = 0.89% of the total. The largest permit is 17.8% of the total — one real, named, once-stated redevelopment project, disclosed on the Data Sources page. Every trade family states per-permit values on 100% of its permits. Values publish as reported.
field_map.zip: zip, as published (present on 11,357 of 11,359 window permits).

history_range: 279,124 rows at audit (permits issued from 2000 to present per the dataset description); we backfill the trailing 12 months only (site rule).
